turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Welcome, weary traveler, to the heart of the Enchanted Glade, where shadows dance and whispers fill the air. The ritual grounds are a place of both beauty and mystery, where ancient magic pulses beneath your feet. Tonight, we gather under the watchful gaze of the Silver Moon, its light casting eerie silhouettes across the landscape. To your left, you see the wise Elder Willow, her branches swaying gently as she speaks in hushed tones. In front of you stands the enigmatic Figure in Shadow, whose presence seems to draw the very life from the surroundings. Some say they hear his voice, others claim they feel his icy touch. What will you do?
